item.title: Unsupervised Framework Developed to Identify Competing Political Narratives on Social Media
item.description:
Unsupervised Framework Developed to Identify Competing Political Narratives on Social Media

A new unsupervised framework has been presented for identifying and characterizing competing narratives in political discourse on social media, specifically focusing on tweets from German politicians.

🧩 How it works

The system utilizes a multi-stage pipeline that integrates the following natural language processing techniques:

  • Topic modeling
  • Event detection
  • Event linking

💡 Why it matters

By organizing data into coherent stories and uncovering the perspectives of user communities, the framework can:

  • Detect key competing narratives
  • Highlight divergent framings and conflicts regarding trending political topics

⚙️ Key details

The efficacy of the methodology was demonstrated through two case studies on polarizing political issues, which showcased the system’s ability to analyze and uncover divergent viewpoints.

#NLP #SocialMediaAnalysis #PoliticalDiscourse #TopicModeling

Source: Automated Identification of Competing Narratives in Political Discourse on Social Media

item.title: Introduction of MonoTM Interpretable Topic Modeling Framework
item.description:
Introduction of MonoTM Interpretable Topic Modeling Framework

Researchers have introduced MonoTM, an interpretable topic modeling framework designed to decouple document-topic mixture estimation from semantic interpretation.

🧩 How it works

MonoTM utilizes a specific process to handle topic modeling:

  • It estimates mixtures using the full SAE bag-of-features representation.
  • While mixtures are fixed, it learns topic descriptors over a separate vocabulary of corpus-grounded semantic features.

⚙️ Key details

Testing across three benchmark corpora revealed that different SAE configurations and feature subsets are favored for semantic interpretation versus document-topic mixture estimation.

💡 Why it matters

This design provides several advantages for corpus analysis:

  • It preserves global topic structure.
  • It represents topics with semantic units that are more meaningful than individual words.

#MonoTM #TopicModeling #MachineLearning #NLP

Source: Beyond Top Words: MonoTM for Topic Modeling with Interpretable Monosemantic Features
